name: args
dockerfile:
ARG V
FROM scratch AS out
ARG W

name: max-base
dockerfile:
FROM busybox:1.36
COPY a /a
RUN echo x > /b

name: max-stages
dockerfile:
FROM busybox:1.36 AS b
RUN echo x > /x
FROM scratch
WORKDIR /w
COPY --from=b /x /y
COPY --link a /l
COPY --chown=1:2 a /o
COPY <<EOF /h
hello
EOF
